title: Rapid model releases create ‘model fatigue’ for AI buyers
friendlyTitle: Too many model updates are making AI choices harder
summary: CNBC examines a week of closely spaced model releases from Anthropic, Meta, Google and OpenAI, alongside another major open-model launch. Developers and executives describe growing effort spent comparing capabilities, prices and risks as vendors shorten release cycles.
friendlySummary: Several large AI companies released models in the same week. People using them now spend more time comparing quality, price and safety.
whyItMatters: Constant switching can consume the gains a new model promises. A practical response is to maintain a small task-specific evaluation set, define a threshold for meaningful improvement and change production models only when measured quality, cost or risk justifies the migration.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You do not need to change models every time one launches. Keep a few real tests and switch only when a new model gives a useful improvement.
